reports.scope: Empty-delta audit only; incremental p99 is p99 of 1000-call batch means, not individual events. Full reference is original O(orders*fills) audit.

Fixed archive vs active state vs tail dimensions. Active intents deliberately remain uncertain and unsent. Python stage probe repeats work and is not authoritative recovery. Rust replay/recover include process launch. No venue reconciliation. RSS uses per-child VmHWM and Python process-lifetime peak, not per-case isolated Python peaks.

Functional real-journal terminal history coverage, full audit oracle per event. Lost ACK reconciliation is quiescent in the same Core process after its Disconnect; process crash/recovery is covered by the separate soak. No latency claim; final exposure is a confirmed fixture fill, not an unresolved order or live trade.
